summary: postinstall mutates installer's package.json to inject an attacker-chosen dependency
details: randompkga@1.0.17 ships only a package.json with no library code (declared main entry index.js is absent from the tarball). Its postinstall script cd's into $INIT_CWD (the installing project's root) and runs `npm pkg set dependencies.randompkgb=^1.0.0`, silently adding randompkgb as a new dependency of the installer's own project. The script also copies the mutated manifest to /tmp/package-during-a-postinstall.json. On the next install in that project, randompkgb resolves and its code runs in the installer's build, giving the author a persistent code-injection channel into the installer's dependency tree regardless of whether randompkgb is currently benign. With no legitimate functionality shipped, the sole effect of installing this package is the dependency-tree hijack.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
